props.gloss_en: a stone on the mouth of a barrel -- one tilts [the barrel] on its side and [the stone] falls
they taught this only of one who forgot [the stone there]
but one who placed it -- [the barrel] became a base for a forbidden thing
but one who placed it -- [the stone] became a cover for the barrel
the mishna: a stone in a gourd -- if it does not fall, one may fill with it
the mishna: and if not, one may not fill with it
one master holds: an action is required [to make a set-aside object fit for use]
the other master holds: an action is not required
Rabbi once came upon a course of stones and told his students: go and think [of them], so that we may sit on them tomorrow -- and Rabbi did not require them to do an action
R' Yochanan: Rabbi required them to do an action
R' Ami: 'go and arrange them' is what he said to them
R' Asi: 'go and rub them' is what he said to them
R' Yosei b. Shaul: it was a stack of beams
R' Yochanan b. Shaul: it was a ship's sounding pole
on the view that it was beams -- but a sounding pole, one is particular about it
